    text="Delete the repository row; the next install event re-adds it."

procedure index=2 token="2" line=81 title="Re-index search"
  description="" verification=0

scenario index=1 line=94 symptom="The onboard flag exits with \"repo not found\""
  alert="none"
  likely-cause="the App is not installed on the repository"
  step S1.1 line=103 end=107
    text="Diagnose: list the installation's repositories."
    command line=105 lang="sh" body="gh api /installation/repositories --jq '.repositories[].full_name'"
  step S1.2 line=109 end=109
    text="Resolve: add the repository to the installation, then retry Procedure 1."
